note: Cycle-1 EMERGENT chars (seed-missed, discovered on the per-cycle conformance check via old-model role residue): prudence (ormah, 1:4), learning (leqach, 1:5), greed (batsa, 1:19). Raised to characteristics, read, stamped candidate + seed-fed (cycle method 4.4).

dims.v: prudence — shrewd good sense (the wise use of the same craft that, misused, is craftiness)
the simple, to be given it
prudence put into the naive so they are no longer defenceless
the gift to the simple (peti), the counter to naivety

EMERGENT: ormah heads 1:4's purpose ('to give prudence to the simple') yet the seed missed it. Prudence is the sharp, wary good sense the naive lack — bivalent (craftiness in the wicked), here wholly positive. A central Proverbs char, recovered on the cycle check.
learning — the received teaching that is taken in and grows
the wise who increase in it
the wise increasing in learning by hearing
the fruit of the wise's hearing (shama) — what listening accumulates
EMERGENT: leqach ('what is taken/received') is the growing store of teaching the wise add to by listening (1:5) — the object of 'increase'. Seed-missed; recovered on the cycle check.
greed — the covetous grasping after unjust gain that cuts one off
greedily grasping unjust gain — the bent that seizes and, in seizing, destroys the self
welded to the loss of life/nephesh (1:19) — greed takes away the life of its possessor

EMERGENT: batsa (to cut off / be greedy for gain) is the DRIVER of the whole 1:10-19 unit — the covetous grasping the chapter warns against; it names the inner root of the violence. Seed-missed; recovered on the cycle check. Descent read at full weight.
